name: Amon
source:
Amon is always drowsy and is famous for being runaway in Avisos after Beelzebub, the wandering king. He goes wherever he wants to go, and does what he wants to do.

When problems happen in Avisos, it's usually because of Amon. But it is also Amon who solves the most complicated problems in the cleverest ways.

Beelzebub presented Amon with the choker Amon now wears when he first took him in as a subject, telling him to be an obedient dog. It is so tight that it chokes him when he swallows, but Amon likes it, saying it feels like Beelzebub's touch.
